intentions.title: Give `bp tasks` a tall, narrow, always-glanceable portrait TUI that organizes the whole task corpus into epics/clusters/orphans with live work always on top
intentions.evidence: program.go doc comment: 'a tall, narrow, always-glanceable live pane organized by epics, active work on top, latest movement first'; board.go BuildBoard is described as 'the ENTIRE zero-config organization policy for the portrait task TUI'; types.go Board struct with Now/Epics/Clusters/Orphans/Next fields; render.go Render draws 'the whole portrait frame for a 60-100col x 100+row pane'

intentions.title: Make BuildBoard a pure, deterministic function of (snapshot, repo, now) so goldens and unit tests never depend on wall-clock or network
intentions.evidence: board.go: 'It is pure: the same (snapshot, repo, now) always yields the same Board, and it never reads the wall clock'; render.go Render doc: 'It is pure — no I/O, no tea, no network — so goldens are the primary gate'

intentions.title: Never trust event payloads as truth — every SSE/poll signal only marks the board dirty and triggers a full refetch, eliminating drift and ghost rows
intentions.evidence: live.go: 'The one iron rule (charter decision #4): events NEVER carry truth. An SSE frame only says "something moved"; the refetch says WHAT is true. We refetch the whole snapshot and rebuild the board — never apply an event payload incrementally'

intentions.title: Curate a deeply-scored NEXT intent strip (continuity, unblock leverage, well-formedness, zombie discount) instead of a raw priority-sorted ready queue
intentions.evidence: board.go D65 comment + scoreReadyTask/resolveNext: nextContinuityBoost=200, nextLeveragePer=30, nextWellFormedBoost=100, nextZombiePenalty=50; user directive quoted verbatim: 'What is set as "Next" must be deeply curated'

intentions.title: Compute an honest dispatch Frontier — the maximum set of ready tasks that can be worked in parallel without blast-radius collisions — shared identically by the TUI's IndependentReady count and the `bp task frontier` CLI verb
intentions.evidence: frontier.go: 'This file is the REAL interference model both the TUI count (Board.IndependentReady) and the CLI verb (`bp task frontier`) read — ONE function, so the two surfaces can never drift'; RiskClass tiers (file-isolated/isolated/neighborhood); CrossEdges cross-root block-edge precision; quoted wish about sending out 50 agents safely

intentions.title: Auto-fold the board to what matters now: active work (NOW-pinned claims) always wins, dormant/finished/cancelled sections collapse to single lines or tombstones, and long-closed tasks never flood the view
intentions.evidence: board.go Active/Demoted/Workable logic, finishedGraceAfter, doneCueMax=2 folding regardless of age, CancelledFolded folding at any age (charter wave-10 W10-B), staleBandAfter/staleCountAfter thresholds, sortEpics ranking Active desc then repo-mention then LastActivity

intentions.title: Derive relatedness structure (label clusters, twin near-duplicate detection, focus-window neighborhoods) from the corpus itself instead of requiring authored organization
intentions.evidence: board.go deriveClusters/clusterKey (proj:/area:/shared-label fallback), detectTwins/assignTwins via title-token Jaccard (twinThreshold=0.6, suggestThreshold=0.4), computeFocus/sectionFocus focus-window construction (focusParents/focusSiblings/focusChildren, focusWindowMax=12)

intentions.title: Give every cmux pane a single stable, fencing-safe task-claim worker identity so subagents in the same pane share one lease instead of colliding
intentions.evidence: cmux.go CmuxWorkerID four-tier precedence (BARKPARK_WORKER_ID > cmux-$CMUX_SURFACE_ID > cmux-$CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID > ResolveWorker); doc comment: 'The PANE owns the task, not the individual agent... every subagent's claim renews the pane's ONE lease (re-claim under the same worker = renewal, never a 409)'

intentions.title: Keep the board's semantic color vocabulary (RoleOK/Info/Warn/Danger/Neutral) as state-meaning, never decoration, shared with the CLI's status-role set
intentions.evidence: theme.go: 'The names mirror PR #979's CLI statusRole set (ok/info/warn/danger) exactly so a later reconciliation slice can extract them to a shared internal package without a rename. Color means STATE here, never decoration — RoleFor is the single mapping point'
